title: Thus Spoke Zarathustra
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
description: Nietzsche wintered in Nice for several years in the 1880s. He wrote that part of this book came to him on the steep path up to the village of Èze, which now carries his name.

title: The Garden Party and Other Stories
author: Katherine Mansfield
description: Katherine Mansfield’s best-known collection. She wrote several of these stories at the Villa Isola Bella in Menton, where she spent the winter of 1920 to 1921. She died two years later, at 34.

title: Everybody Was So Young
author: Amanda Vaill
description: Amanda Vaill’s biography of Gerald and Sara Murphy, the American couple whose summers at Cap d’Antibes drew Picasso, Hemingway, Cole Porter, and the Fitzgeralds, and inspired Tender Is the Night.

title: Life with Picasso
author: Françoise Gilot and Carlton Lake
description: The painter Françoise Gilot’s account of her ten years with Picasso, much of it in Antibes and Vallauris after the war. Picasso tried to stop its publication.

title: The Secret Lives of Somerset Maugham
author: Selina Hastings
description: A biography of the English writer W. Somerset Maugham, who lived for nearly 40 years at the Villa Mauresque on Cap Ferrat, between Nice and Monaco, and entertained much of literary Europe there.
